title: Regenerative Turbine Pump

introduction.definition: A regenerative turbine (peripheral or side-channel) pump uses an impeller with many small vanes on its rim that run in an annular channel. Liquid re-circulates between the vanes and the channel many times as it travels around, gaining energy each time, so a small pump can produce high head at low flow.
applications: Liquids with entrained gas or vapour (LPG, refrigerants)
key_points: Tight axial clearances — clean liquids only
Power highest at shut-off; use a relief valve
introduction.summary: In a regenerative turbine pump the liquid enters the side channel and is caught by the small vanes on the impeller rim, flung outward into the channel and returned to the vane roots further round — many times during one trip from suction to discharge. Each pass adds energy, so the pump develops far higher head than a centrifugal pump of the same size at small flows. It can handle some entrained vapour/gas, has a steep, almost linear H-Q curve and power rises toward shut-off, so it needs relief protection.

video_tutorials.title: Regenerative Turbine Pump — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Regenerative Turbine Pump.
A regenerative turbine (peripheral or side-channel) pump uses an impeller with many small vanes on its rim that run in an annular channel.
Liquid re-circulates between the vanes and the channel many times as it travels around, gaining energy each time, so a small pump can produce high head at low flow.
Typical applications include boiler feed for small boilers; liquids with entrained gas or vapour (LPG, refrigerants); car wash and spraying; low-flow high-head chemical services.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Casing with Side Channel & Stripper, Peripheral (Regenerative) Impeller — 36 vanes, Seal Housing / Motor Adapter.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Regenerative Turbine Pump — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Regenerative Turbine Pump.
Check pressure and motor current.
Clean suction strainer.
Check impeller side clearances.
Watch for clearance wear: rapid loss of head. Common cause: abrasives.
Watch for motor overload: trips. Common cause: throttled discharge.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
